title: From FIPS to FPGA with LLM Agents: Measuring What Tests and Reviews Miss in Post-Quantum Cryptographic Hardware
abstract: arXiv:2611.25339v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As LLM agents increasingly generate RTL alongside the tests and reviews that validate it, self-generated evidence is a weak foundation for trustworthy hardware. We present our seven-stage verification-gated workflow, evolved during a post-quantum design port, in which a gate counts only if shown able to fail on negative controls and fault mutants, and reviewer agents audit work before commit. We then audit this evidence with tool-selected netlist mutants, flaw replays, and formal checks. The flow ported an ML-KEM-768/ML-DSA-65 accelerator to a 300 MHz Zynq UltraScale+ key-custody card: all six operations are byte-exact on the board, and it passes all 85 interface-applicable NIST ACVP cases (of 285) and 484 ML-DSA known answers. However, passing module tests overstate the verification strength. translated_title: 借助LLM智能体从FIPS标准到FPGA实现：度量后量子密码硬件中测试与评审所遗漏的问题
translated_abstract: 随着LLM智能体日益同时生成RTL代码以及用于验证它的测试和评审，自生成的证据成为可信硬件的薄弱基础。我们提出了在一次后量子设计移植过程中演化出的七阶段验证门控工作流程，其中只有当某个门控被证明能够在阴性对照和故障突变体上失败时才被视为有效，并且评审智能体会在提交前对工作进行审计。随后，我们使用工具选择的网表突变体、缺陷重放和形式化检查来审计这些证据。该流程将ML-KEM-768/ML-DSA-65加速器移植到300 MHz的Zynq UltraScale+密钥托管卡上：所有六种操作在板上均实现字节级精确，并通过了全部85个接口适用的NIST ACVP测试用例（共285个）以及484个ML-DSA已知答案测试。然而，通过的模块测试夸大了验证强度。在三个RTL模块中，现有仿真门控仅能杀死399个工具选择的网表突变体中的76%……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个针对LLM智能体生成硬件代码的七阶段验证门控工作流，成功将ML-KEM-768/ML-DSA-65后量子密码加速器移植到FPGA上并通过全部NIST测试，同时通过突变测试揭示现有测试和评审仅能发现76%的硬件缺陷，证明自生成的验证证据不足以保证硬件可信。
en_tdlr: A seven-stage verification-gated workflow with LLM agents successfully ported an ML-KEM-768/ML-DSA-65 post-quantum cryptographic accelerator to FPGA, passing all applicable NIST tests, yet mutation testing revealed that existing tests and reviews kill only 76% of netlist mutants, showing that self-generated evidence is insufficient for trustworthy hardware.
